name: Playwright
description: Playwright CLI and a matching browser for agent-driven and project test-suite browser checks.

browser.description: Browser to install: 'auto' picks chrome on x64 and chromium on arm64 (Chrome has no arm64 Linux build). 'none' skips browser install.

cli.description: Install @playwright/cli globally so agents can run playwright-cli.

cliVersion.description: Version of @playwright/cli to install. Pinned to a known-good release rather than 'latest' for reproducible builds; bump deliberately.
